name: void-supercode
description: Void SuperCode - A lightweight code editor

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npx copyfiles -u 2 src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css dist/renderer && npx copyfiles -u 3 src/renderer/styles/*.css dist/renderer/styles && npx copyfiles -u 4 node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs/**/* dist/renderer/vs && npx copyfiles -u 3 src/renderer/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/icons && npx copyfiles -u 4 src/lang/javascript/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/lang/javascript/icons && npx copyfiles -u 4 src/lang/julia/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/lang/julia/icons && npx copyfiles -u 4 src/lang/typescript/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/lang/typescript/icons && npx copyfiles -u 3 node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/renderer/xterm/xterm.css && npx copyfiles -u 3 node_modules/@xterm/xterm/lib/xterm.js dist/renderer/xterm/xterm.js && npx copyfiles -u 3 node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.js dist/renderer/xterm/addon-fit.js && npx copyfiles icon.png dist
